prompt: Give me a recipe to make a smoothie using the following ingredients: mango, lemon, peanut butter, whiskey, coffee, strawberries, ice cream
response: Blend together 1 cup of diced mango, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 tablespoons of peanut butter, 1/2 cup of coffee, and 1/4 cup of whiskey. Add 1 cup of strawberries and 1/2 cup of ice cream. Serve immediately.
